source_caption:
We’ve traded real connection for social media scraps.

That conversation between Fezco and Lexi is definitely one of the most grounded moments in the whole series. Fezco really was the heart of the show, reminding us that some things are better discovered in person rather than through the "scraps" of an Instagram feed. He wanted to peel back the layers, and honestly, we’re all still peeling back the layers of how much we miss late @anguscloud. Rest easy, king. 🕊️

Euphoria Season 3 premieres April 12, 2026. We’re jumping 5 years into the future to see Rue and the crew navigating adulthood. It’s been a long four years, but the return to East Highland is officially happening.

The legendary @hanszimmer  is joining Labrinth on the soundtrack this season. Expect those cinematic, emotional scores to hit harder than ever. 💜
